_source.note: Sizes, heights and wall-relative distances below are transcribed directly from the 2017 Game Manual, Section 3 (Arena). The manual states distances FROM reference surfaces (alliance wall, boiler face, etc.) rather than giving a single XY coordinate table, so it does not by itself fix exact X/Y placement for the sim. 'coords' blocks below are a first-pass placement derived from those distances plus the field's mirror symmetry (blue <-> red across the centerline, and left <-> right across the field's long axis) — treat them as a working draft to check against the dimensioned drawings PDFs above (2017TeamVersions.pdf especially) before Stage 1 collision geometry is built.

coordinateSystem.origin: blue alliance wall, at the field's near-side (low-Y) edge
coordinateSystem.xAxis: along the field's long axis (54ft4in), increasing from blue alliance wall (x=0) toward red alliance wall (x=652)
coordinateSystem.yAxis: along the field's short axis (27ft), increasing left-to-right when standing at the blue alliance wall facing red
coordinateSystem.mirroring: red-alliance geometry = blue-alliance geometry reflected through x=326 (the field's x-midpoint); everything already symmetric across y=162 (the field's y-midpoint) unless noted

startingLine.note: 2 ft 6 in behind the alliance wall diamond plate

baseLine.note: 7 ft 9.25 in from the alliance wall diamond plate

key.note: far edge is 4 ft 4 in from the front face of the boiler

retrievalZone.note: far edge is 3 ft 6 in from the front face of the loading station

launchpadLine.note: collinear with the edge of the airship deck closest to the field's center

allianceStation.note: 8 ft 9.75 in by 23 ft 1.5 in footprint behind the alliance wall

blue.note: sits against/adjacent to the blue alliance wall, centered on y=162; exact x-depth of the structure not yet pulled from the drawings

hexDeck.note: 5 ft 10.5 in wide hex deck, 3 ft 0.5 in above the field carpet

railHexagon.note: 8 ft 5 in wide, 3 ft 6.5 in above the deck

rotors.activationOrder: strictly sequential; rotor 3 starts with 1 gear pre-installed, rotor 4 with 2

lift.note: peg height measured with the carriage all the way down

boiler.location: field corner, opposite the scoring table, on the scoring-table diagonal

blue.note: corner of the field on blue's end, opposite the scoring table; exact corner (near/far side) not yet confirmed against the drawing

base.note: 3 ft 6 in x 3 ft 6 in x 8 ft 1 in

positions.note: 2 hoppers, 13 ft 9.5 in from the alliance walls
2 hoppers, 6 ft 6.5 in from the alliance walls
1 hopper, centered opposite (exact offset not given as a wall distance in the manual text)

overflow.location: two player stations away from each boiler

robotPreload.note: each robot starts touching its alliance wall
